why: A = isFredholm_of_mem_linSet ∧ exists_two_or ∧ nonempty_equiv_of_two ∧ equiv_eq_of_apply_eq_of_two (first two at universes 0; the last two are stated for Sort u and are instantiated at 1, i.e. for types — at 0 they would speak about propositions). B: (1) every orientation o of DET(f, x) has an opposite o' (o'(L) = −o(L) on every fibre), o' ≠ o, and Or^f_x = {o, o'}; (2) for smooth x, y the bijections Or^f_x → Or^f_y are exactly ±o_x ↦ ±o_y and ±o_x ↦ ∓o_y. B ⇒ A: exists_two_or from (1) once one orientation exists (under A's hypotheses Lin(f, x) ≠ ∅ by linSet_nonempty, is convex, hence simply connected, and exists_lineOrientation_apply_eq gives one); the other three conjuncts are proved outright (A's first conjunct via isFredholm_isIndexAt_of_mem_linSet; the two Sort-lemmas are about arbitrary two-element types, which B cannot express). A ⇒ B fails on exactly one hypothesis of exists_two_or that B does not give: Bd.HasScPlusSectionsThrough (sc⁺-sections through every smooth fibre point). It is satisfiable (it holds with sc-smooth bump functions, MPolyfold.AdmitsBumpFunctions.hasScPlusSectionsThrough), and A_to_Bsec proves B under it (the 'opposite' structure of B needs only that two rays of a line are equal or opposite and LineOrientation.eq_of_apply_eq over the convex base). Without it B is not known: B_imp_nonemptyLin shows B forces every Lin(f, x) at a smooth point to be nonempty (over an empty base the unique orientation is its own opposite), which needs sc⁺-sections through −f(x).
B_issue: As for V6_30, B has no hypothesis making Lin(f, x) nonempty; given B ⇒ NonemptyLin, B is false if some Lin(f, x) is empty (possible only without sc⁺-sections through −f(x), e.g. without bump functions). B's Joined x y hypothesis is unused (claim (2) does not depend on it), as the blind side noted.
overlap: 1240 shared project theorems: the vocabulary of DET(f, x)/linSet (sc-calculus, FredholmDet, StrongBundle infrastructure, theorem_3_1_18_preprint) plus the parts of exists_two_or's proof reused to produce one orientation: ChartPoint.linSet_nonempty, ChartPoint.convex_linSet, ChartPoint.isFredholm_isIndexAt_of_mem_linSet, nontrivial_fiber, exists_lineOrientation_apply_eq. Not reused: proposition_6_6_1, exists_two_lineOrientation (the two-orientation count comes from B).
check: #rt_check_soft passes with exists_two_or, nonempty_equiv_of_two, equiv_eq_of_apply_eq_of_two banned. isFredholm_of_mem_linSet cannot be banned: it is the Fredholm witness inside ChartPoint.detLin = DetOn (Lin(f, x)) (isFredholm_of_mem_linSet …), so it occurs in the statements of A and B themselves (OrB, IsOpp, ChartPoint.Or and the instance arguments for DET(f, x)), not only in _proof_N fields; any proof mentioning B reaches it. It is a Prop, interchangeable by proof irrelevance with (isFredholm_isIndexAt_of_mem_linSet hf hL).1, which is how A's first conjunct is proved. B_to_A uses B only for exists_two_or; its other three conjuncts are proved outright (vacuous for the audit).
